notes.title: Shadowforge 12.5. "Surely, a tame lion must be inverted...?"
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SGJi8Mn.png[/img]

"Nay", said the king. He looked at the sky in disgust and smacked his tongue up and down to show a disarray with the real nature of the world. He added to his short answer; "It is true, you can not be the maker of the beholder. But you can change it's desired patterns to the complete opposite.".

[h3]New Shader: Invert Colors[/h3]

Use it to make nice things with B&W or to make something cool instead hot or to hide your face on the internet, perhaps. I just make this software for fun, you do whatever you want with the paintings, haha.

[h3]New Font: Strings Font.[/h3]
A calligraphic font that just connects the letters to make it look calligraphic.

[h3]QoL: Am I in a time machine?[/h3]

Finally the bugs are fixed. Everytime you make a mistake, you insist it was a silly one, until you look back again. Oh no, the barrel and fish eye previews are not like the others, I think now and then...! The issue was that it was nested into the UI and not the surface drawing.

More UI is outlined and the UI placement bug that deletes one UI will behave correctly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rz3zJpB.png[/img]


I am staying on the developer engine which is from 2023... so there will not be anymore cautious changes back and forth. At least to my knowledge.


Might need to fix some more bugs... I am not that happy with the lasso loading times.

Well. Cao there! Hope you have a merry one and a happy new year!

notes.title: Happy Halloween - Major Patch 12.0 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MAIN FEATURE[/h2]

Destiny Tiling (Texture Randomisation Tiling) is something that is great for making authentic work on clothing such as jeans, dresses, shirts, pants and even
mouse pads, covers or go wild and put it behind you on the green screen! Anything is possible with textures. We love textures and always have, it enriches
our minds with eye candy and a sensation of mysteries and thousands of other different emotive affections. It's style, and we love it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/1c5782c01c6a195b1bb4379affe5df4d7f37c22e.png[/img]

[h2]UPGRADED FEATURE[/h2]

Spray like never before in Shadowforge. Now you can spray directly by pressing on the mouse button instead of only selecting it on the right menu
bar and pressing enter, possibly dividing the spray with a number value. The method of pressing the mouse button, which I introduce as Spray 2.0 for
the app, follows an invisible red thread. As if it has it's own destiny and on it grows new seeds, which in this case is a custom or themed sprite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/747504f05d0b1593f9030dceb3578d1fec3ecdbc.png[/img]

[h2]REPLACED FEATURE ON THE QUICK BAR WITH A CONSISTENT AND BETTER FEATURE[/h2]

Say good bye to tick tock color value changing and say hello to SCATTER. The SCATTER is divided to Spray 2.0 and Destiny Tiling, but is
a strong foundation pillar.


[h3]NEW SUB FEATURE[/h3]

Meet Scatter Tiling. A sub feature of a foundation feature. It allows you to pick -- with the brush space value input option -- amount of cloned scattered tiles.
Jointed with the Tile Paint Fill, it might be your deal changer for this update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/2f6b768c49daf8361edad390283c3042cbc3b0d5.png[/img]

[h3]WIDENED USE FOR "W OPTIONS"[/h3]

Now compatible with Spray 2.0 and Texture Randomisation Tiling (but from now on I am going to call it Destiny Tile, because why not, I am 100%
independant and work on this by myself so I can name it what I want. Hehe. But I do take any feedback postively and serious. Anyway, moving on to
the next work that has been scheduled and pushed on...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/2559e55eb8bf2f231e8ba17d59cdb0cee5ac35b0.png[/img]


[h3]BUGS SQUASHED[/h3]
Fixed crash that occured when using the gif upload icon and after that exiting the game.
Now the display is corrected when the preview when you hover on the text for Barrel and Fish distortion is active.


[h3]QOL HEALING[/h3]
The mouse cursor no longer connects with the top camera slider like it used to due to other things taking up Place.

Below image is a character from Bluetail. Having only washed the lightest white into transparency, I decided to try and make a character that was only a quick concept into a portrait painting resembling some kind of oil painting from the 1600's. Keeping the bone structures that were outlined that make this character a personalised design from someone, yet changed into a shaded version with a few textures.

If you are a seasoned Shadowforge painting veteran, you will be right at home in how to do something like this when starting Shadowforge 12.0.

If you're new, read the guide, or TL;DR, ALT + B into CTRL + B into the Red Sphere icon on the Left Quick Bar. Wash a color into transparency with the black and white eraser icon on the Quick Bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36815287/b951b156c9087508a9166034893b8e259b14be94.png[/img]

This means the depth layering won't act as canvas layers. I'm not sure when and if I will add canvas layers to Shadowforge. But I'm pretty happy now with this system.
